headline: Rahul Gandhi detained from protest near PM Modi's house
summary: The Congress leader was forcibly removed by police after demanding the resignation of the Union Education Minister during a sit-in protest.
details: Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, was forcibly removed and detained by police from a protest site outside Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s residence.
The protest was staged against alleged police brutality against students during a march to the Indian parliament and the crackdown on Cockroach Janata Party protesters.
Union Minister of State Dr Jitendra Singh had earlier met Rahul Gandhi at the site, stating that the government had accepted his demand for a parliamentary discussion on the NEET issue.
However, according to Dr Singh, Rahul Gandhi then added a second demand: the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.
The government's top leadership was consulted, but when Rahul Gandhi insisted on the resignation, police used force to remove the Congress leaders from the site.
Other Congress leaders who were part of the protest were also removed by the police during the action.
caption:
Rahul Gandhi forcibly removed from a protest outside PM Modi's house after demanding a minister's resignation.

Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, was forcibly removed and detained by police from a protest site outside Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s residence.

The protest was staged against alleged police brutality against students during a march to the Indian parliament and the crackdown on Cockroach Janata Party protesters.

Union Minister of State Dr Jitendra Singh had earlier met Rahul Gandhi at the site, stating that the government had accepted his demand for a parliamentary discussion on the NEET issue.

However, according to Dr Singh, Rahul Gandhi then added a second demand: the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.

The government's top leadership was consulted, but when Rahul Gandhi insisted on the resignation, police used force to remove the Congress leaders from the site.

Other Congress leaders who were part of the protest were also removed by the police during the action.
